results.title: Señor Apache
results.overview: Fifty-six years after their smash hit “Fue en un café”, the trace of stardom still beats in the present of Los Apson, the creators of border rock from Agua Prieta, Sonora. From a distance, in his prison cell, lead singer Frankie Gámez accompanies saxophonists Lichi García and Gil Maldonado on a crusade to reclaim the band's legacy.

results.overview: The film follows Lena, a withdrawn high school student who is mocked by her peers and finds comfort in visits from a vampire named Viktor.

results.title: Little Dreamer
results.overview: During an entirely ordinary breakfast, little Lily lets her imagination run wild. She is gazing at a bowl of chocolate breakfast cereal, and suddenly everything around her changes. On her way to school, her all-so-familiar home, the school bus and the playground become a new magical universe. The morning might be usual, but for the red-haired girl, it will be filled with the most unusual adventures…

results.title: Who Wants to Steal Your Beach?
results.overview: You know that beach you go to for a bit of rest? They want to take it away from you.  The so-called "Beach Amendment" (PEC das Praias)—championed in the Senate by Flávio Bolsonaro—could change who owns the Brazilian coastline, an area that belongs to everyone, by handing control over to hotels, resorts, and luxury condominium developments.  In practice, these developments would take over the entire beach area, leaving access to the sand and the sea exclusively to tourists—while you, as a Brazilian resident, would lose your access to the beach.  This model already exists in places like Cancún and Jamaica: there, the people in bikinis are foreigners, while the locals are the ones wearing uniforms and working. And that is exactly what could happen if Flávio Bolsonaro becomes president of Brazil.

results.title: Cara y cruz
results.overview: María manages the daily demands of family life, although she and Jordi believe they share the responsibilities equally. An unexpected reversal of roles lets Jordi discover the invisible work involved in caring for their home and children.

results.title: A Fragile Paradise
results.overview: As storms intensify and the future of Fire Island grows uncertain, those who care for the island reveal what it means to protect a place they love that may not last.

results.title: Here and There
results.overview: Here and There explores grief after the loss of a loved one, embarking on a journey between the worlds of the living and the dead. Through animation, light, and shadow, it portrays the emotional transformation of mourning from a sensitive, intimate perspective. This short film offers a poetic reflection on death and the new forms of connection between those who remain and those who are gone.
